roofWallVariant.derivation: Actual upper wall mesh bounds cut every lower roof layer and split the lower long ridge. The height profile is explicitly resampled at the new hole boundary. roofWallVariant.accessScope: Roof penetration and support fixture only. Upper doorway is geometrically open; no stairs, access route, original FloorPlan or controller is claimed.
